description: This file defines an interface for a generic object pool and an abstract class for pooled resources that can be returned to the pool, supporting resource management and reuse within the Orleans streaming infrastructure.

classes.name: PooledResource<T>
classes.description: An abstract class representing a resource that is pooled and can be returned to its pool, supporting reset and disposal logic.

methods.name: Allocate
methods.description: Method to allocate a resource from the pool.

methods.name: Free
methods.description: Method to return a resource to the pool.

methods.name: SignalPurge
methods.description: Method to handle purging of the resource, default implementation calls Dispose.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Method to dispose of the resource and return it to the pool.

methods.name: OnResetState
methods.description: Method to reset the resource to its initial state after being purged.
